up: Retrieve the compound chembl_id, preferred name, standard activity type, standard value, standard relation, and standard units for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4296186. Only include exact activity values where standard_relation equals '='. Join activities with assays on assay_id, and join with molecule_dictionary on molregno to get compound identifiers and names. Do not apply any row limits.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name AS preferred_name, a.standard_type AS standard_activity_type, a.standard_value, a.standard_relation, a.standard_units FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4296186' AND a.standard_relation = '='
